tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i dmod bskul log 'dren tshar gcod dpa' bo'i nga ro zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rdo rje phur pa'i dmod bskul log 'dren tshar gcod dpa' bo'i nga ro zhes bya ba/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pa gang zhig 'di'i drag po'i gtor chen gyi las bya ba'i tshe dmod bskul 'di bzhin bya ste/ kī la ya la sogs sngags tshang ma'i mjug tu gzhi snying gcig sgril gyi sngags/ thun sngags rnams kyi/ hoḥ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga/ sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po sogs rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa rnams dang / mkhas pa mi gsum/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ yul dbus kyi slob dpon bhi ma la mi tra/ bal po'i slob dpon shrī la mañju/ gnyags dz+nya na ku ma ra/ 'khon ston klu dbang bsrung ba sogs rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa rnams dang / gcung ston rdo rje rin chen nas bzung rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / zhe sdang 'dul ba'i gtso bo 'dod chags dag pa'i yul dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum/ bdud 'dul khro bcu yab yum/ thabs shes che mchog nyi shu/ las mdzad sgo ma bzhi/ sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga ste/ dpal chen po'i lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa gcig 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du yang dpal chen he ru ka'i spyan sngar zhing bcu'i gshed dmar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal ldan dkar mo nyi zla/ bdud mgon nag po thod phreng can/ dam can bdag nyid re ma ti/ re ma dzi/ re ma dzā/ re ma dzu ste mched bzhi dang / shwa na ma wa'i gdong can/ spyang ki'i gdong can/ 'phar ba'i gdong can/ khyi'i gdong can te mched bzhi dang / sa bdag ma rdo rje spyi byin/

rdo rje ya byin/ rdo rje bse byin/ rdo rje phag byin ma ste mched bzhi dang / rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / rdo rje kun tu bzang / rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso ste bdud kyi bu mo mched bzhi dang / rdo rje g.yu bun ma/ rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ rdo rje klu mo/ rdo rje drag mo rgyal te gnod sbyin gyi bu mo mched bzhi dang / rdo rje bod khams skyong / rdo rje sman gcig ma/ rdo rje g.ya' mo bsil/ rdo rje gzugs med ma ste sman btsun gyi bu mo mched bzhi ste dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ bse lcags dung gsum gyi skyes bu gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgyas sgo ma bzhi la sogs pa mdor na dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i spyan sngar srog snying phul zhing dam bcas pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams gtor ma dang / bdud rtsi dang / rak+ta dang / khams gsum dus gcig tu bsgral ba'i mchod pa dang / kha tham gyi phyag rgya'i sbyor ba'i mchod pa phul zhing phrin las bcol ba dang thugs dam bzlas pas rgyud bskul ba'i mthu stobs dang nus pa la brten nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshigs pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa sogs bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa/ pha ma dgra bcom bkrongs pa sogs mtshams med lnga byed pa/ mchod rten bshig cing dgra bcom sun 'byin pa sogs de dang nye ba lnga byed pa/ srog don bka' dam las nyams sogs nyams pa bdun tshang ba/ khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs spyi dang / bye brag tu dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa gdung brgyud sde 'khor 'bangs dang bcas pa la bsam sbyor log pa'i sgo nas byad dang sbyor ba rtsub pa/ bsam ngan dug sbyor nag po kha 'jam gyis kun nas blangs te/

mtho ba'i zhabs 'dren/ dma' ba'i gong gnon/ mnyam par 'gran sems phrag dog la sogs pa'i sgo nas bsam sbyor ngan pa snga dgra lags la bkal ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra sdang zhing gnod pa'i ma rig nag po dpung dang bcas pa thams cad kyi skyob pa'i lha dang phrol/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ sa yi brtan phur phyung / mkho ba'i yo byad gtor/ steng gi mi brgyud chod/ bar gyi nor brgyud chod/ 'og gi phyugs brgyud chod/ bag nan du gyur cig big nan du gyur cig bag mā ra ya gtad du gyur cig ud kar du gyur cig skaṃ shing du gyur cig dbang du gyur cig dzi hor du gyur cig las kyi rlung dmar gyis rgyab nas phul cig 'jigs pa'i mun nag gis mdun nas bsus shig drag po'i khro bo rnams kyis snying nas drongs shig lus bye ma bsnyil ba bzhin du thong zhig mgo ardza ka'i dog pa ltar tshal par khos shig kha so sil bu ra lhab cig mig 'bras thang la lhung zhig dam nyams yin gyis bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum gling bzhi phran jo mo gling gsum phyogs kyi gnas srung rnams la gser skyems 'bul tshig khyung lung lha mo'i gsol kha/ srid zhi'i mgron la gtor 'bul bsdus pa/ rmug la khu spe chos sde'i gzhi bdag thog rgod bkra shis kyi gsol kha bse khrab pa'i gsol mchod/ mang phur srung mar mchod gtor 'bul tshul/ 'god pa'i lha lnga dang bstan ma bcu gnyis mchod tshul lo/ /pho lha skya ser gsol mchod rnams bzhugs so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal rdo rje phur pa'i dmod bskul log 'dren tshar gcod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
